headlines.title_en: PBOC conducts 1 trillion yuan outright reverse repo operations today; experts say this reflects a moderately loose monetary policy stance
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data August 14 - To keep banking system liquidity ample, on August 14 the People's Bank of China will conduct a 1 trillion yuan outright reverse repo operation via fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price pricing. Correspondingly, 1 trillion yuan of 6-month outright reverse repos mature on August 14. Thus, this operation achieves a hedge, leaving the outright reverse repo balance at 6.3 trillion yuan. Dongfang Jincheng Chief Macro Analyst Wang Qing analyzed that given the overnight interbank rate (DR001) has been running below the policy rate since August 4, this may be one reason the August 6-month outright reverse repo did not extend its increase. headlines.summary_en: From August 12 to 13, 2026, PBOC Deputy Governor Zou Lan attended the first BRICS Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors meeting of the year in Jaipur, India. headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.title: 市场押注澳洲联储将于11月加息以对抗通胀
headlines.summary: 投机投资者正越来越多押注澳洲联储将在11月再次加息，原因是通胀水平仍高于央行目标。掉期市场定价目前预计，到11月澳洲联储加息25个基点的概率约为45%，高于周二澳洲联储利率决议前的38%。在澳大利亚证券交易所衍生品市场交易的2026年11月银行间现金利率期货，当天成交活跃度升至逾三个月高位，显示市场投机兴趣增强。这些押注表明，市场越来越怀疑澳洲联储的紧缩周期尚未结束。尽管政策制定者本周维持利率不变，但由于通胀仍高于澳洲联储2%-3%的目标区间，交易员将继续关注即将公布的物价和就业市场数据，以寻找今年是否需要再次加息的线索。

headlines.title_en: Markets bet on RBA rate hike in November to combat inflation
headlines.summary_en: Speculative investors are increasingly betting the RBA will hike rates again in November, as inflation remains above the central bank's target. Swap market pricing now implies roughly a 45% probability of a 25bp RBA hike by November, up from 38% before Tuesday's RBA decision. Trading in the November 2026 interbank cash rate futures on the ASX derivatives market surged to a more than three-month high on the day, showing stronger speculative interest. These bets suggest the market increasingly doubts the RBA's tightening cycle is over. Although policymakers held rates this week, with inflation still above the RBA's 2%-3% target range, traders will continue watching upcoming price and labor market data for clues on whether another hike is needed this year.

headlines.summary_en: Brazil's Finance Ministry recently said Brazil plans to issue yuan-denominated sovereign panda bonds in the Chinese market for the first time within 2026, with a planned issuance size of 5 billion yuan. Looking at the overall panda bond market, Wind data shows that as of August 13, year-to-date panda bond issuance reached 202.475 billion yuan, up 73.57% year-on-year, also exceeding the full-year 2025 figure of 183.56 billion yuan and the full-year 2024 figure of 194.8 billion yuan, setting a record high. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title: 中信证券：粘胶长丝行业有望进入供需偏紧与价格中枢上行阶段
headlines.summary: 中信证券研报表示，出口需求持续增长、存量供给接近满负荷运行，粘胶长丝行业有望进入供需偏紧与价格中枢上行阶段。印度传统服饰消费增长带动中国粘胶长丝出口放量，2025年行业出口量同比增长18.2%至11.4万吨，2026年上半年进一步同比增长30.9%；同时，2025年国内行业开工率已升至89.8%，半连续纺产能可能面临政策淘汰、环保改造及搬迁压力。中信证券预计2026年—2028年行业将呈现供需缺口，产品价格具备向上弹性。重点推荐头部企业。

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: Viscose filament industry expected to enter phase of tight supply-demand and higher price center
headlines.summary_en: CITIC Securities research report says export demand continues to grow and existing supply is near full capacity, so the viscose filament yarn industry is expected to enter a stage of tight supply-demand and rising price center. Growth in Indian traditional apparel consumption has driven China's viscose filament yarn exports, with 2025 industry exports up 18.2% year-on-year to 114,000 tons, and further up 30.9% year-on-year in H1 2026; meanwhile, domestic industry operating rates rose to 89.8% in 2025, and semi-continuous spinning capacity may face policy elimination, environmental renovation, and relocation pressure. CITIC Securities expects an industry supply-demand gap from 2026-2028, with upward price flexibility. Top companies are recommended.

headlines.title_en: August 14 midday close: ChiNext Index pulls back after rally, up 0.65%; CPO concept stocks strengthen collectively
headlines.summary_en: 1. The Shanghai index fluctuated and adjusted in the morning, while the ChiNext index surged then pulled back. CPO concept stocks strengthened, with Sinomatix, Aled, Gongjin Electronics and others hitting limit up. Optical fiber concepts pulled up intraday, with Hangzhou Cable hitting limit up. Rare earth permanent magnet sector rose, with Jintian Co. hitting limit up. On the downside, computing power leasing concepts adjusted, with Chengdi Xiangjiang hitting limit down; the power sector fell, with Meiyan Jixiang down over 8%. Declines outnumbered gains, with over 3,600 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing markets in the red, and morning turnover of 1.4 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai index fell 0.21%, Shenzhen Component rose 0.08%, and ChiNext rose 0.65%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, CPO, optical fiber, high-speed copper cable connections, rare earth permanent magnets and other sectors led gains; film & TV, power, dairy, short drama and other sectors led declines. 3. Across both markets, 1,891 stocks rose with 40 hitting limit up; 3,152 stocks fell with 5 hitting limit down; 21 stocks broke their limit-up boards.

headlines.title_en: A-share midday review: Shanghai index hits high then falls 0.21%; electronic chemicals, CPO, non-metallic materials lead gains
headlines.summary_en: The three major A-share indices were mixed in early trading. As of midday, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.21%, Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.08%, ChiNext Index rose 0.65%, Beijing Stock Exchange 50 fell 0.84%, and STAR 50 fell 0.57%. Total market turnover was 1.3964 trillion yuan, down 203.4 billion yuan from the previous session, with over 3,400 stocks falling across the market. In terms of sectors and themes, electronic chemicals, non-metallic materials, CPO, optical fiber concepts, and components sectors led gains; film & TV theater chains, power, culture media, gaming, and dairy sectors led declines. On the board, electronic chemicals opened higher and extended gains, with Sinomatix up 20% limit, while Si Xin New Materials, Haixing, Longcheng Technology, Guanggang Gas, and Zhongju Core led gains. headlines.title: 中国电动卡车在南亚与东南亚销量飙升
headlines.summary: 在伊朗战争推高燃料成本、加速区域电气化进程之际，中国对其他亚洲国家的电动卡车出口大幅攀升。在美国与以色列于2月28日发动战争后的四个月内，中国重型电动卡车出口较去年同期增加逾一倍，达16,823辆。其中一半销往南亚与东南亚，对南亚出口增加至原来的五倍以上，对东南亚出口增长至原来的近三倍。GlobalPetrolPrices.com数据显示，自战争爆发以来，斯里兰卡柴油价格上涨48%，菲律宾上涨57%

headlines.title_en: Chinese electric trucks see surging sales in South and Southeast Asia
headlines.summary_en: Amid Iran's war pushing up fuel costs and accelerating regional electrification, China's electric truck exports to other Asian countries have surged. In the four months after the US and Israel launched the war on February 28, China's heavy electric truck exports more than doubled year-on-year to 16,823 units. Half went to South Asia and Southeast Asia, with exports to South Asia rising more than fivefold and to Southeast Asia nearly tripling. GlobalPetrolPrices.com data shows that since the war broke out, diesel prices in Sri Lanka have risen 48% and in the Philippines 57%.

headlines.title: 抖音等入股未来不远机器人
headlines.summary: 天眼查工商信息显示，近日，上海未来不远机器人科技有限公司发生工商变更，新增抖音旗下北京量子跃动科技有限公司、纳爱斯浙江投资有限公司等为股东，同时，注册资本由约628万人民币增资约769万人民币。该公司成立于2022年9月，法定代表人为陈奕荃，经营范围包括智能机器人的研发、人工智能基础软件开发、工业机器人制造等。（第一财经）
